tools.name: read_io_data
tools.description: Select one target mode and provide only its parameters. address: Read raw bytes from the specified device, slot and subslot. alias: Resolve those values through DEVICE_MAP_FILE. Supported by mock and optional cifx backends. cifx requires an explicitly enabled, precommissioned Hilscher controller and an exact process-image mapping; it validates controller identity, AR state and provider quality and obtains a new firmware handshake snapshot. It does not start the bus or configure devices. The network DCP backend does not provide cyclic I/O.

tools.name: write_io_data
tools.description: Select one target mode and provide only its parameters. address: Write output bytes to the specified device, slot and subslot. alias: Resolve the target through DEVICE_MAP_FILE. Requires PROFINET_WRITES_ENABLED=true. Supported by mock and optional cifx backends. cifx requires explicit initialization opt-in, a commissioned controller and an exact full-submodule mapping; a successful write confirms controller process-image acceptance, not physical application. A failed or interrupted native write may have applied and must not be automatically replayed. The network DCP backend does not provide cyclic I/O.

tools.name: discover_devices
tools.description:
Discover PROFINET IO devices.

        Network backend: multicasts a DCP Identify All request on PROFINET_INTERFACE and lists every
        device that answers within `timeout` seconds (needs raw-socket privileges). Mock backend: lists
        the devices simulated by profinet-mock-server. Each device reports device_name, mac_address,
        ip_address, subnet_mask, gateway, vendor_id, device_id, device_type and type_of_station where
        known (null otherwise). meta.backend says which backend answered.
         The cifx backend uses commissioned mappings and does not perform DCP discovery.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for answers, 0.5-60 (default: PROFINET_DCP_TIMEOUT, 5)
timeout.title: Timeout

tools.name: identify_device
tools.description: Request one DCP identification flash sequence. Live backend accepts duration_s=3 only; the device controls actual LED timing. Mock supports other durations. Requires both PROFINET_WRITES_ENABLED and PROFINET_CONFIG_CMDS_ENABLED. Acknowledgement is not verification of the physical LED. Supported by network and mock backends; cifx does not configure stations.

tools.name: load_gsd_file
tools.description:
Parse a GSDML device description file: device identity, access points and modules.

        Returns metadata (vendor, vendor/device IDs, device name, GSDML version), the device access
        points with their usable modules, every module with its fixed submodules and its pluggable
        submodules (resolved from the SubmoduleList; unresolved references are flagged and the module
        gets submodules_incomplete=true), and input/output sizes in bytes (null when a data type's size
        is unknown). Relative paths are also looked up in
        PROFINET_GSD_PATH. Files are cached and re-parsed when they change on disk.

tools.name: get_connection_status
tools.description: Report backend settings and reachability. Mock: check a TCP connection. Network DCP: reachable is null; use discover_devices. cifx: never initializes hardware; before the first explicitly enabled I/O call reachable is null, otherwise checks the owned controller identity and running/communication state. Controller reachability does not establish individual device quality; each cifx I/O validates its mapped AR and IOPS/IOCS.
